crownPassive.name: Guess my name
crownPassive.text: Each round, while planning, you may secretly pick one enemy hero. If it planned an action, the action is cancelled and it takes 2 damage. If it planned nothing, Rumpelstiltskin takes 4 damage. Each enemy hero can be picked only once per fight.

bond.name: Märchen kin
bond.text: +1 Attack for each other Märchen hero you field.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Straw into gold
actions.text: Get back one item you have already used this fight.
